name: Depth-Guided Sequential Editing
aliases: View-Consistency-Aware 3D Editing of Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A sequential editing strategy that reflects 2D edits in 3D by defining key views, editing them sequentially, and projecting modifications to subsequent views to enforce geometric consistency.
summary: Depth-Guided Sequential Editing is a fast NeRF editing method that ensures multi-view consistency by sequentially editing key views and projecting them to others, avoiding diffusion model integration.
